resources.string: Maintenance is running. Wait for it to finish before trying again.
Refresh the list and check which file is in use before making changes.
Check the bridge diagnostics on the computer before changing any authorization files.
Check the selected file and name, then choose the file again.
Read the file status before attempting another token refresh.
The service denied access. Check account permissions or access restrictions.
The service rejected authentication. Check this authorization on the computer.
Reconnect to the bridge, then check the latest result.
Check which account Codex is using before deciding whether to restart or switch again.
The cause is unknown. Check the details or request the result again.
The outcome is unconfirmed. Check the file state and error details before repeating the operation.
A scheduled check failed. Inspect its details before taking manual action.
Codex reports the same email as the file. If this is the expected login and workspace, you can continue. The earlier restart result is kept in diagnostics.
Codex reports a different email. Save any work, check the login on the computer, then verify again.
There is insufficient account information to compare. Check the active login on the computer.
Codex reports that it is signed out. Sign in on the computer, then check again.
The request timed out. You can request the result again.
